fields.hero_prompt: Build HOA survey questions that ask my community's 214 homeowners to rank five amenity upgrades before the board sets next year's budget.

faq_plan.q: How do I create hoa survey questions?

plan.angle: The top 10 for hoa survey questions are buyer checklists (questions to ask before buying into an HOA), a law firm blog, forum threads and a property manager interview list; none shows a board surveying its own homeowners or what the answers changed. This page is for the board side: four HOA surveys built from a prompt and run to a decision, an amenity ranking before the budget, a landscaping review before a contract renewal, a 30-day check with new owners, and a garage EV charger survey in a condo building. The how-to gives the writing rules boards need (one answer per home, cost beside each option, a close date before the meeting), and the FAQ covers length, anonymity, renters, response rates and sharing results.
tab_stories: Ternwood Ridge HOA emails all 214 homeowners a ranking of five amenity upgrades before the budget meeting, 131 homes answer, 58 of 131 rank longer pool hours first, and the board funds the pool hours and moves the clubhouse repaint to the next year.

Calloway Bluff's board asks owners to rate the landscaping contractor before the March renewal, 61 of 97 rate leaf pickup 2 or lower out of 5, the community manager gets an email, and the renewed contract adds weekly leaf pickup each fall.
Dunmore Glen emails every new owner 5 questions 30 days after closing, 4 of the last 11 say they never learned the trash pickup day, and the welcome email now lists it in the first line.

Lockhaven Towers asks its 88 condo units about one shared EV charger in the garage on their phones, one question per screen, 70 units answer, 47 of 70 say they would use it, and the board gets two installer quotes for the annual meeting.
